Key.Original: Log maritime diagnostics to the RPT. Turn this on before reporting a fault.
Key.English: Log maritime diagnostics to the RPT. Turn this on before reporting a fault.

Key.Original: Water depth in metres used by the tidal current u = eta sqrt(g/H); the engine exposes no bathymetry, so this is a scenario parameter
Key.English: Water depth in metres used by the tidal current u = eta sqrt(g/H); the engine exposes no bathymetry, so this is a scenario parameter

Key.Original: Compute the surface ocean current from the wind and the tide
Key.English: Compute the surface ocean current from the wind and the tide

Key.Original: Angle in degrees the wind-driven current is deflected to the right of the wind (left in the southern hemisphere)
Key.English: Angle in degrees the wind-driven current is deflected to the right of the wind (left in the southern hemisphere)

Key.Original: Bearing in degrees of the tidal flood axis; the current runs along it and reverses on the ebb
Key.English: Bearing in degrees of the tidal flood axis; the current runs along it and reverses on the ebb

Key.Original: Fraction of the 10 m wind speed carried as surface current; the empirical range is 1 to 3 percent
Key.English: Fraction of the 10 m wind speed carried as surface current; the empirical range is 1 to 3 percent

Key.Original: Air-to-sea coupling weight for the sea-surface temperature; low = high thermal inertia, high = sea follows air quickly
Key.English: Air-to-sea coupling weight for the sea-surface temperature; low = high thermal inertia, high = sea follows air quickly

Key.Original: Weight given to the current wind when smoothing the sea state; higher values build the sea faster
Key.English: Weight given to the current wind when smoothing the sea state; higher values build the sea faster

Key.Original: Half-range of the predicted tide height in metres
Key.English: Half-range of the predicted tide height in metres
